# Papikondalu Tourism

> Private Godavari river boat tour operator based in Rajahmundry, Andhra Pradesh, running Papikondalu boat tours since 2004 from Rajahmundry and Bhadrachalam. Own fleet of three boats (Aswini, Sri Godavari, Srilaxmi; 100 to 150 passengers each). Bookings by phone or WhatsApp on +91 9848323488 or by email to aswinigodavari@gmail.com.

Papikondalu is a range of forested hills where the Godavari narrows into a gorge between Rajahmundry and Bhadrachalam. There is no road through the gorge, so it is seen by boat. Best season: October to March; monsoon trips depend on the river level. Prices are quoted per date; see the price section of the tour guide.

## Plan and book

- [Papikondalu tours guide](https://www.bhadradripapikondalu.com/papikondalu-tours): routes, Rajahmundry vs Bhadrachalam comparison, timings, prices, what to carry, safety, cancellation
- [Rajahmundry to Papikondalu one day tour](https://www.bhadradripapikondalu.com/packages/rajahmundry-papikondalu-packages): same-day return, Perantalapalli stop, lunch on board
- [Bhadrachalam to Papikondalu two day tour](https://www.bhadradripapikondalu.com/packages/bhadrachalam-papikondalu-packages): temple visit, overnight stay near the hills, ends in Rajahmundry
- [Sirivaka night stay and camping](https://www.bhadradripapikondalu.com/packages/sirivaka-night-stay-package): overnight riverside camp in the Papikondalu hills
- [All tour packages](https://www.bhadradripapikondalu.com/packages)
- [Contact and booking](https://www.bhadradripapikondalu.com/contact)
